briefing.title: Texas vs. Alabama

claims.text: Texas defeated Alabama 34–24 in the 2023 regular season at Bryant-Denny Stadium.
Texas recorded 454 total yards, including 349 passing yards; Alabama recorded 362 total yards, including 255 passing yards.
Alabama threw two interceptions and had two turnovers; Texas had no turnovers.
Texas converted 7 of 18 third downs, while Alabama converted 5 of 14.

limitations: Selected team statistics only; no play-by-play, return statistics, or detailed defensive statistics.
